 }
========
# Batch task creation

`POST /api/v1/tasks/batch` accepts ordinary and grouped batches:

```json
{
  "group": true,
  "groupName": "album",
  "opts": {"path": "/downloads"},
  "reqs": [
    {"rid": "resolved-resource-id", "opts": {"selectFiles": [1]}},
    {"req": {"url": "https://example.com/cover.jpg"}}
  ]
}
```

Each member accepts `rid` or `req`. A nonempty `rid` takes priority and creates a
task from the cached resolve result. A member's `opts`, when present, replaces
batch `opts` as a whole; omitted fields do not inherit individual batch values.
Members without `opts` use batch `opts`. BT file selections use the indexes from
the resolve result. Requests without `rid` continue to work.

For groups, batch `opts.path` selects the parent directory. Members inheriting
batch options, or with an empty path, use the reserved group directory. Explicit
relative member paths are resolved under that directory; do not prefix them with
the batch parent path. For example, parent `downloads` and member path `nested`
place the member in `downloads/<group name>/nested`. Absolute paths under the
parent directory preserve their relative structure within the group. In ordinary
batches, an empty member path uses the configured default download directory.

All members are attempted. If at least one task is persisted, the response is
successful and contains the created task IDs. A task that fails to start after
being persisted is included; use the existing task controls to retry it.
Successful tasks are kept when other members fail. If every member fails, the
API returns an error and removes any newly reserved empty group and directory.

Both ordinary and grouped batches now return an object in `data`:

```json
{"code": 0, "msg": "", "data": {"taskIds": ["task-1", "task-2"], "parentId": "group-id"}}
```

Ordinary batches omit `parentId`. **This replaces the former array response for
ordinary batches.** The outer `code`/`msg`/`data` envelope is unchanged. Clients
must read `data.taskIds`; there are no per-member results. A successful response
completes the batch, including partial success, so clients must not automatically
resubmit missing members.

With `group: true`, the server generates the group ID and reserves its directory.
Creation does not accept a client group ID or append to an existing group. Group
metadata remains available through the existing task list and detail responses;
`parentId` identifies membership for group operations.

input.rationale: 本手册遵循「从零开始、由浅入深、源码与实践结合」的路径设计：第一单元让读者建立 Gopeed「Go 核心 + Flutter 外壳」的整体认知并能亲手构建运行；第二单元先攻克贯穿全项目的领域模型（Request/Resource/Options/Task/全局配置），本轮因 Task 新增 ParentID 分组字段与 CreateTaskBatch 模型扩展而小幅更新；第三、四单元进入架构脊柱——Fetcher 协议抽象与 Downloader 任务生命周期，本次增量（1e36599 feat(tasks): group extension folder downloads）引入 TaskGroup 模型、task_group 存储桶与 CreateDirectBatchWithResult 批量语义，故在第四单元新增「任务分组与批量创建」讲义，同时 Pause/Continue/Delete 因组 ID 展开与删除持久化恢复被大幅重写，对应讲义标记为 rebuild；第五到七单元按协议逐个深潜（HTTP 多连接分块、BitTorrent、HLS/FTP/ED2K），本轮协议代码零改动全部保持；第八单元自底向上讲解服务层、REST、桥接与部署，tasks/batch 接口响应由数组改为 CreateTaskBatchResult 对象故对应讲义更新；第九单元扩展系统生产代码未变保持；第十单元更新自动分类讲义以覆盖 decideDownloadDirForTask 的分组目录决策；第十一单元以测试、并发关闭与 Flutter 对接收尾——本轮 Flutter 端任务分组 UI 与大量新测试并入故对应更新。讲义间用 depends_on 显式声明先后关系，49 篇的规模与项目 250+ Go 文件加完整 Flutter 应用的体量相匹配，每篇只解决一个主题并配有可落地的代码实践。

call_89310b08cce441ccad7734c2.head: 1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e
call_89310b08cce441ccad7734c2.rationale: 本手册遵循「从零开始、由浅入深、源码与实践结合」的路径设计：第一单元让读者建立 Gopeed「Go 核心 + Flutter 外壳」的整体认知并能亲手构建运行；第二单元先攻克贯穿全项目的领域模型（Request/Resource/Options/Task/全局配置），本轮因 Task 新增 ParentID 分组字段与 CreateTaskBatch 模型扩展而小幅更新；第三、四单元进入架构脊柱——Fetcher 协议抽象与 Downloader 任务生命周期，本次增量（1e36599 feat(tasks): group extension folder downloads）引入 TaskGroup 模型、task_group 存储桶与 CreateDirectBatchWithResult 批量语义，故在第四单元新增「任务分组与批量创建」讲义，同时 Pause/Continue/Delete 因组 ID 展开与删除持久化恢复被大幅重写，对应讲义标记为 rebuild；第五到七单元按协议逐个深潜（HTTP 多连接分块、BitTorrent、HLS/FTP/ED2K），本轮协议代码零改动全部保持；第八单元自底向上讲解服务层、REST、桥接与部署，tasks/batch 接口响应由数组改为 CreateTaskBatchResult 对象故对应讲义更新；第九单元扩展系统生产代码未变保持；第十单元更新自动分类讲义以覆盖 decideDownloadDirForTask 的分组目录决策；第十一单元以测试、并发关闭与 Flutter 对接收尾——本轮 Flutter 端任务分组 UI 与大量新测试并入故对应更新。讲义间用 depends_on 显式声明先后关系，49 篇的规模与项目 250+ Go 文件加完整 Flutter 应用的体量相匹配，每篇只解决一个主题并配有可落地的代码实践。

data.head: 1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e
data.rationale: 本手册遵循「从零开始、由浅入深、源码与实践结合」的路径设计：第一单元让读者建立 Gopeed「Go 核心 + Flutter 外壳」的整体认知并能亲手构建运行；第二单元先攻克贯穿全项目的领域模型（Request/Resource/Options/Task/全局配置），本轮因 Task 新增 ParentID 分组字段与 CreateTaskBatch 模型扩展而小幅更新；第三、四单元进入架构脊柱——Fetcher 协议抽象与 Downloader 任务生命周期，本次增量（1e36599 feat(tasks): group extension folder downloads）引入 TaskGroup 模型、task_group 存储桶与 CreateDirectBatchWithResult 批量语义，故在第四单元新增「任务分组与批量创建」讲义，同时 Pause/Continue/Delete 因组 ID 展开与删除持久化恢复被大幅重写，对应讲义标记为 rebuild；第五到七单元按协议逐个深潜（HTTP 多连接分块、BitTorrent、HLS/FTP/ED2K），本轮协议代码零改动全部保持；第八单元自底向上讲解服务层、REST、桥接与部署，tasks/batch 接口响应由数组改为 CreateTaskBatchResult 对象故对应讲义更新；第九单元扩展系统生产代码未变保持；第十单元更新自动分类讲义以覆盖 decideDownloadDirForTask 的分组目录决策；第十一单元以测试、并发关闭与 Flutter 对接收尾——本轮 Flutter 端任务分组 UI 与大量新测试并入故对应更新。讲义间用 depends_on 显式声明先后关系，49 篇的规模与项目 250+ Go 文件加完整 Flutter 应用的体量相匹配，每篇只解决一个主题并配有可落地的代码实践。
